d:
Kristy's Pastime is a series about Kristy Jordan, the mother of Victoria and former wife of volleyball coach Matthew. A former "stuck-up bitch," racist and snobby, after a traumatic divorce she rediscovers her sex appeal through the men's volleyball team and finds a new passion: Big Black Cocks. Turned on by racist dirty talk and voyeurism, her main story is shaped by three key episodes:

1) "Back to the Team": Kristy Jordan is a chaste and respectable mother, a typical rich, somewhat snobbish and secretly racist woman. She has a past as a volleyball player, as her height reveals. For this reason, she is called by her husband Matthew to replace the coach of the men's volleyball team. The team consists of black, athletic guys who immediately notice Kristy's voluptuous curves even under her modest and sober clothing. Soon Kristy discovers that Matthew is cheating on her with a girl from the volleyball team, unleashing her hidden desires...

2) "The Wannabe Hoe": One year later, the young Jessie is on vacation with her boyfriend Walt in Madagascar. There she meets Kristy, who is also on vacation and is now completely uninhibited. On the beach, Jessie watches Kristy having an encounter with a black vendor. From there, a chain of events leads Jessie to become a "wannabe hoe."

3) "A New Mother": An interquel in which Kristy hosts her daughter Victoria, back from college. By pure coincidence, during those days Mrs. Jordan is renovating her swimming pool; naturally, the entire crew consists of strapping black men. Little by little, Victoria discovers why her parents got divorced.

4) "Education of a Son": Kristy has never stopped seeing Marcus from the men’s volleyball team. Marcus is completely infatuated with Kristy, while she remains quite uninterested in the boy in that sense. Everything seems to be business as usual—until Marcus’s father discovers what his son has gotten himself into and the real cause of his problems at school and in sports.
